specimen_label: Sagittal section of the head and neck

marker.description: A paper tag attached to a pin pointing to a structure in the lower part of the model, likely the larynx or pharynx.

main_question: Identify the structure indicated by the tag.
main_explanation: The tag points to the region of the larynx (voice box) in the anterior neck, situated below the pharynx and above the trachea.

supporting_question.question: Which of the following structures is located immediately superior to the larynx?
supporting_question.explanation: The pharynx is the muscular tube that lies superior to the larynx and posterior to the nasal and oral cavities.
